theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cc_radial_homotopy_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m • (β (t • y)).curryLeft y) x + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (m + 1) • (exteriorDerivative β (t • x)).curryLeft x = β x
